_why: Row 2934: the codex GREEN effort policy (medium), its overrides (--effort, HMAD_GREEN_EFFORT, inherit) and the one-step --escalate to high. Each guard must bite, or a policy that silently stopped applying looks the same as one that applies.

mutations.name: drop-the-new-behaviour-policy
mutations._mechanism: A codex GREEN on a new-behaviour task silently falls back to the inherited effort.

mutations.name: drop-the-wiring-policy
mutations._mechanism: A codex GREEN on a wiring task silently falls back to the inherited effort.

mutations.name: sever-the-resolved-effort-from-the-block
mutations._mechanism: The resolved effort is computed but the block is built from the raw --effort, so the policy never reaches the dispatch.

mutations.name: ignore-escalate
mutations._mechanism: --escalate is accepted but the dispatch keeps the policy effort.

mutations.name: accept-escalate-with-an-explicit-effort
mutations._mechanism: --escalate with --effort is not refused, so which effort ran is ambiguous.

mutations.name: policy-outranks-an-explicit-effort
mutations._mechanism: An explicit --effort is ignored in favour of the policy.

mutations.name: ignore-the-inherit-escape
mutations._mechanism: HMAD_GREEN_EFFORT=inherit is passed through as an effort value instead of restoring inheritance.

mutations.name: drop-the-escalation-marker
mutations._mechanism: An escalated dispatch leaves no record that it escalated.

mutations.name: hide-the-effort-line
mutations._mechanism: The block no longer says which effort h-mad chose, so the policy acts silently.
